item.title: Twenty Four
item.description: I am in the prime of my life. Literally, and mathematically. 24 can be represented as 2 * 2 * 2 * 3, all primes. Though this is a bit of a cheat. All numbers can be represented as a product of primes. So I can confidently claim that, mathematically, I am always in my prime.
